name: Postman MCP Server
description: Connects AI agents to Postman workspaces, collections, environments, specs, and mocks via a remote or local MCP server, including running collections and generating client code.

skills.name: Collection Management
skills.description: Creates, updates, forks, tags, and comments on Postman collections, folders, requests, and responses from an MCP client.

skills.name: Workspaces and Environments
skills.description: Creates workspaces and environments and manages environment variables so agents can configure API testing setups.

skills.name: Run Collections
skills.description: Runs Postman collections and monitors to test APIs, using the local server when target APIs live on your workstation.

skills.name: Spec and Code Sync
skills.description: Generates specs from collections, keeps specs and collections in sync, and produces client code from API definitions.
